An adventurer exploring the icy Formorgar mines, near Svargrond, went deeper than his strength allowed. Follow the map to the Formorgar Mines and find his skeleton next to the stairs: inside are a {item:Shard}, 100 gp, a {item:Bullseye Potion}, a {item:Crossbow} and 20 {item:Power Bolt|Power Bolts}.
An adventurer exploring the icy mines ventured deeper than his powers allowed...
No minimum level, but the recommended level is **120**.
Access to the {wiki:Formorgar Mines|Formorgar Mines} (through {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest|The Ice Islands Quest}).
The {spell:Levitate} spell (to go up on the path west of Svargrond and to come back down)
Enough potions: there are many dangerous creatures on the way
There are many dangerous creatures on the way: it is a good idea to do this quest at the same time as the last mission of {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest|The Ice Islands Quest}.
{creature:Demon|Demons} and/or {creature:Destroyer|Destroyers} brought by other players may appear.

If you are not in **Svargrond** yet, take a boat there (for example in Carlin or with {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais): talk to the port captain and say {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}. You arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat, in the **east** part of the city.
Following the map to the mines

Leave **Svargrond** to the **west**, use {spell:Levitate} to go up and follow the path on the map to the entrance of the {wiki:Formorgar Mines|Formorgar Mines}. At the end of the path go down the stairs to enter the mines.
Numbered route from Svargrond to the Formorgar Mines
First floor of the mines: the yellow circle is the exit ramp; the pink circles are the stairs to floor 2

On the way and in the mines there are voodoo cultists ({creature:Novice of the Cult|Novices}, {creature:Acolyte of the Cult|Acolytes}, {creature:Adept of the Cult|Adepts} and {creature:Enlightened of the Cult|Enlightened of the Cult}), {creature:Crystal Spider|Crystal Spiders}, {creature:Ice Golem|Ice Golems}, a {creature:Lost Soul}, {creature:Nightmare|Nightmares} and a {creature:Plaguesmith}.
Opening the skeleton next to the stairs
Once inside the Formorgar Mines, follow the second map to the stairs. Near them is a skeleton's body: open it to receive the rewards.
Path inside the mines to the skeleton next to the stairs
Shard, 100 gp, Bullseye Potion, Crossbow and 20 Power Bolts

There is no quick exit: go back the same way on the second map to the first floor and go up the exit ramp (yellow circle on the first floor map). Outside, retrace the route of the first map to **Svargrond**; use {spell:Levitate} to go down where you went up. To leave the island, take {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat ({key:hi}, {key:carlin}/{key:thais}/{key:venore}, {key:yes}).
First floor: the yellow circle marks the ramp out of the mines
